description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Requirement Access to the location before the fight starts.

Rig the ground you expect to fight on. Choose up to three 10-foot squares; each becomes a hazard that triggers when an enemy enters it, dealing damage equal to two of your weapon's damage dice with a Reflex save against your class DC for half. You may detonate any of them yourself as a free action instead. Unspent rigs are recovered afterward, so long as you can get back to them.
